notes.title: Update 0.2, February 17.
notes.content:
* Bug fixes.
* Added the ability to change the screen resolution in the game settings.

* Territory expansion added.
* Added Minions. Ability to sell them your items.
* Added coins. Ability to create them.
* Added 2 new biomes: Winter and Cursed.
* New weather conditions. Snowfall.
* Added decorations. Ruins.

The release of this update has been greatly delayed. I'll try to make small updates and release them more often.
The next update is coming soon.

notes.title: Update 0.1a, February 5.
notes.content:
This is the "Alpha 0.1a" update.

* Added a tutorial. Hopefully, the gameplay will be clearer.

In a couple of days, expect a new update. I will add some content. Also in the next update, the in-game settings will be expanded.
